evidence.reason: The availability gates omit fields the panels actually consume. The disposition gate at line 180 does not include `/status`, although `d.status` is read to classify re-fixes, so a disposition whose status availability is `not-collected` can still pass `usable()` as `fixed`. The review gate at line 199 includes only `/findingFingerprints`, while `covered()` reads `/coverage` and `/vendorCompletion`; because `covered()` checks only their recorded values and not their availability entries, a review with incomplete coverage or vendor-completion evidence can still establish a covered range for the re-fix and missed-finding panels. This is an ordinary implementation defect, not a new requirement.
